scope: Observed Arlarwade/Ayar-compatible simple font subsets in mm-grammar.pdf, keyed by SHA-256 of each embedded font program. Not a universal Ayar byte map; not production-integrated.
method: All page content streams, no Form XObject traversal. Raw bytes are attributed per embedded font hash; existing Ayar decoder output (including its /ToUnicode legacy bridge) is used only as a provisional offline seed. No vector matching, imposter cleanup or reorder is used. A byte enters the provisional one-code-point map only if its output is not in the union of observed orphan-mark flags, has a legacy bridge, and does not share that output with another observed byte in the same subset. The visually overlapping ၀/ဝ and ရ/၇ readings are excluded as contextual ambiguities. A scorer flag is not proof of a wrong mapping, and a matching seed is not semantic verification. Unresolved contexts and compound values are retained.

engineEvidence.method: Complete matches in the manifest-verified Engine walker with equal reference Unicode and mapped-code-point counts. Counts are matching raw windows, not independent occurrences. They depend on the provisional surrounding seed and are supporting evidence only; multiple candidate values remain possible.

visualOrderRules.scope: Raw slots first; rearrange these leading slots only after decoding. Suffix slots remain in their existing order. No other marks are normalized by these rules. Raw orphan flags are retained and do not themselves mean an error.

visualOrderEvidenceMethod: All observed page-stream runs under provisional seed values. Compares raw orphan flags to flags after applying only the four shared patterns; unknown/empty byte values are boundaries. Pattern matches and changes in flags are evidence of visual order, not verification of byte meanings or overall accuracy. Form XObjects are not scanned.
